items.title: Sam Dutrey Interview
items.q: I think George Bakay and some of the others that did that, they had their teeth worn down their teeth.

ctx.x: Covering both lips. Well, the teeth, I mean both upper and lower. And he always said that your father once pointed out, said go around and look at all the clarinet players and you'll see the ones that put their teeth on and have their teeth worn down there. Fess said, yeah, I went around and sure enough, some of them that, I think George Bakay and some of the others that did that, they had their teeth worn down their teeth. Did you ever have any trouble that way of actually wearing your teeth? Well, I don't know.
It may be, but I have noticed because I used the teeth up there, but I was very seldom on my teeth. Yeah. And that's why I say give you better lip control. Yeah.
